scope: Responsive interactive conversation proposal; no product implementation changes

directions_considered.name: 기존 카드 다듬기
directions_considered.tradeoff: 비용은 작지만 도구·답변의 같은 시각적 무게와 좁은 모바일 본문을 유지한다.

directions_considered.name: 대화 중심 작업 공간
directions_considered.tradeoff: 본문 위계를 단순화하고 실행 기록을 접으며 검토는 보조 pane으로 분리한다. 기존 데이터 계약을 유지하며 presentation 분해가 필요하다.

directions_considered.name: IDE 중심 화면
directions_considered.tradeoff: 항상 보이는 파일·diff·로그가 코드 검토에는 유리하지만 일반 대화와 모바일에 과도한 구조를 만든다.

interaction_contract: Desktop Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts newline; composition never sends. Mobile Enter inserts newline.
Sending during a turn queues a draft; interrupt-and-send is explicit.
Offline and uncertain delivery preserve draft. Reconnecting never sends automatically.
Skin, theme, inspector and conversation changes preserve draft, attachments, quote, tools and scroll.
Approval names command and scope; decision remains as a receipt.
Review exposes file, diff and line reference. No actual file changes.
Dialogs trap focus and restore it; Escape closes; focus is visible.
Concise state announcements only; transcript is not a live region.

implementation_boundaries.existing: Message identity, drafts, attachment, reply, approval, queue and lifecycle remain owned by existing stores.
implementation_boundaries.presentation: Turn grouping, concise header, composer toolbar, responsive inspector and delivery notices.
implementation_boundaries.requires_capability: Diff payloads, per-line review context and detailed progress need validated provider/daemon events.
implementation_boundaries.prototype: Browser-local fixtures; no provider, filesystem write, Git or backend connection.
